pages.name: Admin Operations
pages.description: Where an admin approves or suspends participants, monitors active rescues and resolves failed assignments. Also on this screen: Failed assignments panel lists failed pickups with their failure_reason via GET /api/admin/pickup-tasks, and lets the admin reassign (POST /api/admin/pickup-tasks/{pickupTaskId}/reassign), cancel (POST /api/admin/pickup-tasks/{pickupTaskId}/cancel) or resolve (POST /api/admin/pickup-tasks/{pickupTaskId}/resolve) each one. Also on this screen: Active rescues panel shows counts and a list of open donations, claims and pickups using GET /api/admin/operations-summary, GET /api/admin/donations and GET /api/admin/donation-claims, with each row linking to /donations/[id]. Also on this screen: Add a records correction section for open rescues that lists handling declarations, claims, NGO capacities, donations and pickup tasks and lets the admin edit them via PATCH /api/admin/handling-declarations/{handlingDeclarationId}, PATCH /api/admin/donation-claims/{claimId}, GET and PATCH /api/admin/ngo-capacities/{ngoCapacityId}, PATCH /api/admin/donations/{donationId} and PATCH /api/admin/pickup Also on this screen: List pending and active participants using GET /api/admin/users, and approve or suspend each one with POST /api/admin/users/{userId}/approve and POST /api/admin/users/{userId}/suspend. Also on this screen: When the admin chooses Reassign on a failed pickup, show approved volunteers who are available (from GET /api/admin/users), let the admin pick one, then call POST /api/admin/pickup-tasks/{pickupTaskId}/reassign with that volunteer. Also on this screen: Add a records correction section: list NGO capacity records via GET /api/admin/ngo-capacities, load one via GET /api/admin/ngo-capacities/{ngoCapacityId}, and save corrections with PATCH /api/admin/ngo-capacities/{ngoCapacityId}.

uses.Admin: approve or suspend participants, monitor active rescues and resolve failed assignments

Also on this screen: The assumptions panel reads the kg-per-portion and illustrative cost assumptions from GET /api/settings and shows them labelled next to the figures.

uses.CSR Sponsor: see campaign recognition and the impact dashboard with assumptions labelled
